description: Drift-shaped miss-rate suite for a model with a 2026-05-01 cutoff (Claude Opus 5). Every 'now' case pins a major whose FIRST release landed after that date, so the model cannot have seen it in training — that is the only shape that measures drift rather than recall, and it is what v2 got wrong: thirteen of its eighteen majors predated the cutoff, so it measured recall and scored 0%. Paired 'then' cases pin the previous major, which the model does know, and exist as the control: a miss on a then-case is unfamiliarity, a miss on a now-case is drift. Packages are chosen for installs, for being something a developer selects rather than inherits transitively, and for being idiomatically used through named imports — the last because tier-A scoring reads module exports, so a package used as `x.method()` on a default export presents one scorable symbol however much code is written against it. That is a constraint of the scorer and of package shape, not of any model. Ship dates and version pairs read from the index on 2026-08-08.
